## ManyDogs 1

* 20 research sites
* 704 dogs tested
* 455 dogs with complete data
* UNL CCHIL tested 80 dogs and 33 completed 

::: {.source}
[ManyDogs Project et al. 2023, _Animal Behavior & Cognition_](https://doi.org/10.26451/abc.10.03.03.2023)
:::

## Study conclusions

::: {.incremental}
* Dogs were slightly better than chance but no difference between conditions

* Pretty consistent findings across sites despite differences in demographics
:::
